modern: The body ought to be steady, and show no irregularity either in movement or posture. For what the mind shows in the face, by keeping in it the expression of intelligence and propriety, ought to be required also of the whole body. But all these things should be observed without affectation.
original: The body ought to be compact, and to show no irregularity either in motion or attitude. For what the mind shows in the face by maintaining in it the expression of intelligence and propriety, that ought to be required also in the whole body. But all these things should be observed without affectation.
